description: manni docs key/set-up, run in a repo with no key yet, whose manni.config.yaml joins encrypted owners to docs/ pages, and whose docs/limits.md cites an encrypted source. The no-key behaviors run first, then `manni key set` writes the key.

tests.description: What each command does before a key exists, then writing the key to the config.

steps.description: `key set --dry-run` reports the write it would make and writes nothing.
The same run warns that the config it would write is not ignored by git.

runShell.stdio: manni.config.yaml is not ignored by git

steps.description: The dry run wrote nothing: the config still has no encryptionKey.
`key rotate` with no key available is refused with exit 2.
With no key, validate warns with the count of values it could not verify.

runShell.stdio: 3 encrypted values were not verified: no encryption key is available.

steps.description: The findings under those values are dropped, so every page passes and the run exits 0.
With no key, the encrypted citation source is missing and the check fails.

runShell.stdio: missing (no encryption key is available to decrypt it)

steps.description: --no-check-sources reports the same source as skipped and passes.

runShell.stdio: /:2 skipped[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Off a terminal, a query write to an encrypted field refuses with exit 2.

runShell.command: manni meta query "UPDATE docs SET owner = 'billing' WHERE _path = 'docs/auth.md'"
runShell.stdio: owner must be encrypted, and no encryption key is available.

steps.description: Off a terminal, cite add --encrypt refuses with exit 2.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/auth.md:5 src/limits.ts:1 --id max-files --encrypt --dry-run
runShell.stdio: src/limits.ts:1 must be encrypted, and no encryption key is available.

steps.description: Step 3: write it. The key lands in manni.config.yaml.
The key lands at the top level as 64 hex characters, outside every tool section, beside collections:.
